set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; test "$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK" | tee /tmp/tracker-p1-install.txt; grep -q '^Success' /tmp/tracker-p1-install.txt; OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p1-s22-20260912"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 3; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" exec-out screencap -p > "$OUT/radar-p1.png"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-p1-a.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/tracker-p1-a.xml "$OUT/radar-a.xml" >/dev/null; sleep 4; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-p1-b.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/tracker-p1-b.xml "$OUT/radar-b.xml" >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import re, hashlib
out=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p1-s22-20260912"
def cards(path):
    root=ET.parse(path).getroot(); rows=[]
    for n in root.iter():
        if n.attrib.get('clickable')!='true': continue
        m=re.fullmatch(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
        if not m: continue
        x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups()); w=x2-x1; h=y2-y1
        if w>=650 and 70<=h<=400 and y1>=180 and y2<=2300:
            rows.append((x1,y1,x2,y2,h))
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0]))
a=cards(out/'radar-a.xml'); b=cards(out/'radar-b.xml')
print('P1_CARD_CANDIDATES_A',len(a),'HEIGHTS',[r[4] for r in a[:10]])
print('P1_CARD_CANDIDATES_B',len(b),'HEIGHTS',[r[4] for r in b[:10]])
if a and b:
    print('P1_FIRST_CARD_HEIGHT_STABLE',a[0][4],b[0][4],a[0][4]==b[0][4])
p=out/'radar-p1.png'; print('P1_RADAR_SCREENSHOT_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'BYTES',p.stat().st_size)
PY
echo P1_PHYSICAL_LAYOUT_CAPTURE_PASS
